name: somi
description: A workflow plugin for coding agents: say what you want or pass a ticket, and it picks the right workflow and keeps the cost down, while your agent stays in charge.

commands.name: somi-config
commands.description: Show and change the models each tier uses, the quality limits, and check the setup.

commands.name: somi-deliver
commands.description: Run a piece of work as SoMi's staged workflow: scout, build, verify and review, each on its cost tier, through to the end.

commands.name: somi-quality
commands.description: Check code against SoMi's quality limits: this branch by default, or the whole codebase.

commands.name: somi-review
commands.description: Review the current changes or a named diff once.

commands.name: somi-status
commands.description: Show open work, findings and decisions.

commands.name: somi
commands.description: Give SoMi any request or ticket, and it routes the work to the right workflow.
